newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudanese president names new junior ministers.
newsitem.headline: Sudanese president names new junior ministers.

text.p: Sudanese President Omar Hassan al-Bashir has appointed four ministers of state, or junior ministers, state radio said on Thursday.
Lieutenant-General Mohamad Abdel Gadir Idris, a former armed forces spokesman and recently deputy chief of staff for training, became state minister in the Ministry of Defence.
Major-General Hassan Osman Dahawi, a former head of internal security, has been appointed state minister in the Ministry of Social Planning.

Gutbi Mahdi, a diplomat and a former ambassador to Tehran, was named state minister in the office of President Bashir and director of external security, a position previously held by Major-General Mohamed Ahmed Mustafa al-Dabi.
Ahmad Mohamad al-As, former chief of the relief commission, became state minister in the Ministry of Interior.
It was not immediately clear if they replaced other state ministers or whether they would work alongside them. Some Sudanese ministries have three junior ministers.
